findings.summary: The previous attempt finding (415 json_required on body-less writes) is already fixed upstream: httpClient.ts now sends Content-Type application/json on every POST/PUT/PATCH with a `{}` body by default. This unit did not need to edit it, and requireJsonWrites is untouched.

`pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts` was not run: those specs belong to 4-integration-e2e-features and do not exist yet. AC-dm-38/39/46 runtime evidence is deferred to integration.

evidence.summary: src/api/preferencesApi.ts checked against server/validation/preferenceSchemas.ts and server/services/preferenceService.ts: partial PUT, focusCompanyId nullable (null clears it), tourSeen merges per key, GET returns focusCompanyId null for an archived company.

SettingsPage renders "Como ler os resultados" (guidance, not a financial analysis; every diagnosis keeps its calculation version; new ones use RULES_VERSION; updates never change old scores) and "O que o assistente do Play pode ler", which lists exactly the RULE-dm-17 fields (health, plus name, stage, most-blocking dimension and last-diagnosis date for each active company) and says no money values or answers are visible. Security note per OQ-6 (plan:45).

messages.text: PreferencesProvider (src/features/preferences/PreferencesProvider.tsx) wraps <App/> in main.tsx and renders children only after GET /api/preferences resolves (loading/error+retry screens otherwise). usePreferences() returns { preferences: Preferences, savePreferences(update: PreferencesUpdate): Promise<Preferences> }. A save applies at once; on failure it restores the last saved value and rejects with the ApiError. It applies html[data-theme] and color-scheme. First-run should call savePreferences({ usageMode, focusCompanyId }) and the tour savePreferences({ tourSeen: { owner|consultant: true } }).

App.tsx registers `inicio` as a placeholder <Navigate to="/empresas" replace/>; replace its element with HomePage. AppShell nav already links Início -> /inicio, Minha empresa -> /empresa/:focusCompanyId (owner mode with focus) or Empresas -> /empresas, and Configurações -> /configuracoes. It also shows the mode chip and the theme toggle (data-aioson-id theme-toggle).

AppShell exports only AppShell. The header right side is HeaderTools (mode chip + ThemeToggle); add the tour "?" button there. Hide the nav during #/boas-vindas if the wizard needs it (the prototype hides it). The index route still redirects to /empresas, and the wizard owns that decision (BR-dm-11).

SettingsPage is composed of SettingsSection blocks (UsageModeSection, ThemeSection, ResultsGuideSection, AssistantSection, SecuritySection). Insert <BackupSection/> after ThemeSection to match prototype order; SettingsSection(title, description, dataId) is local to the file.

Run `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts` once 4-integration-e2e-features creates them. Selectors: radiogroups aria-label "Modo de uso" and "Tema", select #settings-focus-company (owner mode), data-aioson-id settings-assistant-fields, theme-toggle, mode-chip. The whole UI is gated on GET /api/preferences, so if that route is not mounted in server/app.ts every screen shows the "Não foi possível abrir o FitPulse" error.
